note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 6.3 and HEAD code (coa.go coaReplayWindow, pruneReplayLocked, eventTimestampState). TestRFC5176DuplicateAndTimestampWindowsBothHoldInside confirms at coaReplayWindow-10s that a same-socket duplicate gets cached octets with one teardown and an Event-Timestamp of that age gets Disconnect-ACK. TestRFC5176DuplicateAndTimestampWindowsBothEndOutside confirms at coaReplayWindow+10s that a same-socket duplicate runs afresh (two teardowns) and an Event-Timestamp of that age is silently discarded (still two teardowns).
